analysis_name: Return on Investment of Calling for Reinforcements
methodology: Establishes a formula that quantifies Wukong's shift from 'fight first, ask later' to 'instantly becoming an errand runner for Guanyin' - the actuary mode

formula.formula_text: ROI = (problem-solving efficiency x favor cost x marginal cost of the next request) / (time spent x loss of personal prestige)
formula.formula_explanation: The higher the ROI, the more worthwhile it is to call in reinforcements

components.description: How fast and how thoroughly reinforcements solve the problem
Favor consumed by asking a rescuer - the closer the bond, the lower the cost

components.component: Marginal cost of the next request
components.description: Difficulty of asking again next time - usually lower after the first request
Time spent fetching reinforcements - affects team progress
Prestige Wukong loses after asking for help

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: Deploying Guanyin in person was too costly · severe loss of prestige
rescue_cases.analysis: The very first request for reinforcements summoned Guanyin in person · highly efficient but extremely costly · and Guanyin became a standing dependency thereafter.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: The right remedy · a small cost solves a big problem
rescue_cases.analysis: Bodhisattva Lingji is the specific counter to Yellow Wind · the right remedy · low time cost and small reputation loss · the highest ROI.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: First proactive request to Guanyin · establishes long-term cooperation
rescue_cases.analysis: Wukong learns to ask for help proactively · Guanyin takes Red Boy as the Boy of Good Wealth · a long-term partnership is built.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: Deploys top-tier resources to handle Laojun's own mount
rescue_cases.analysis: The Diamond Snare stole every deity's weapon · ultimately Laojun had to descend in person · severe loss of prestige.
Guanyin points the way · the Mao Sun Star Officer's rooster conquers the scorpion · precise Five-Phase matching.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: Old friends turned foes · heavenly siege · the highest cost
rescue_cases.analysis: Three attempts at the Plantain Fan plus a heavenly siege · old friends turned foes · the longest time and greatest prestige loss.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: An internal Buddhist matter · handled in a closed loop
rescue_cases.analysis: Maitreya Buddha came in person to reclaim him · handled internally within the Buddhist camp · Wukong learns to find the right person.

rescue_cases.monster: The Three Demons of Lion-Camel Ridge
rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: Top-tier resources resolve a top-tier crisis · extremely efficient
rescue_cases.analysis: Tathagata Buddha came in person · all three demons were taken · the most efficient solution to a top-tier crisis.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: An adopted daughter returns to her father · a heavenly family matter
rescue_cases.analysis: Heavenly King Li's adopted daughter returns to her father · a classic case of kinship-based affiliation.

rescue_cases.roi_interpretation: Nine-Headed Lion answers his master's call · no resistance
rescue_cases.analysis: One call from Taiyi the Merciful Celestial and he submits · no resistance · high efficiency.

Early · instinctive.characteristic: Fight first; ask for help only if that fails
Early · instinctive.insight: ROI swings widely because the rescuer network is unfamiliar

Middle · learning.characteristic: Begins to learn to ask for help, but is still working it out
Middle · learning.insight: Low ROI because the network is not yet established and the favor cost is high

Late · actuary.characteristic: Instantly becomes an errand runner for Guanyin - actuary mode
Late · actuary.insight: ROI rises because the network is established; go straight to the principal

roi_insights: The Yellow Wind Demon case proves: the right remedy beats resource rank · even a minor bodhisattva can instantly dispatch a great demon
The Bull Demon King case proves: old friends turned foes + a heavenly siege = the highest cost · the emotional cost is the dearest
A late-stage ROI rebound: Wukong rises from 1.8 (Bull Demon King) to 5.0 (Lion-Camel Ridge) as he learns to calculate
Guanyin becomes the standing rescuer: diminishing marginal cost · first 2.4 → second 4.17 → third outright recruitment
The Lion-Camel Ridge case: a top-tier crisis + top-tier reinforcements = peak efficiency · the Tathagata arrives in person and instantly takes all three demons
